entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: Enumerable/Queryable.MaxBy/MinBy overloads with a result selector #138086
  • Span<T>.Reverse scalar paths may access improperly aligned references #138077
  • BigInteger: multiplication of small values 9x slower in .NET 11, inlined code zeroes 2 KB of stack per call #138076
  • Access violation in the JIT (emitter::emitOutputRR) crashes vstest.console on Windows; then "Fatal error while logging another fatal error" #138075
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: NegotiateStream_SecurityRequirmentNotMeet_Throws does not throw on NativeAOT Windows #138074
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: NegotiateStream NotEncrypted authentication reports encryption on NativeAOT Windows #138073
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Runtime_134489.TestEntryPoint cannot start a thread on browser WASM #138072
  • DispatchProxy fails for interface methods returning `ref` or `ref readonly` #138069
  • JIT: CSE doesn't consider two comparisons with swapped operands equal #138063
  • [API Proposal]: ReflectionBlockedAttribute to remove the reflection metadata of types that nothing reflects over #138057
  • [API Proposal]: TypeMapping.TryGetValue and ITypeMapValue<TValue> to read interop type map data without exposing Type #138056
  • Mono LLVM SpanHelpers.Fill implementation incorrectly early-exits on value = 0 #138051

Closed

  • JIT: (bug) x64 `idiv` reads 4 bytes from a `short` local's stack home (reg-optional small-typed divisor) #137902
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) x64 Vector256/Vector512 `WithElement` re-reads an address-exposed receiver after the value operand's side effects #137900
    12.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Build break: NativeAOT restore has circular project dependency #138047

    12.0.0
  • Android drive enumeration returns escaped mount paths that cannot be used with filesystem APIs #137813
  • DispatchProxy: calling a method with a non-null pointer argument throws NullReferenceException #136451
  • Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.UseWindowsServiceTests.CanDisposeServiceWithoutStarting test failure #137746
    12.0.0
  • Failing test: Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.UseWindowsServiceTests.CanDeleteServiceWhenRemoteProcessFails #137647
    Future
  • JIT: (bug) multi-dimensional array receiver local is re-read after index side effects (spurious `NullReferenceException`) #137638
    12.0.0
